summary: Time-bounded evidence playback with per-entity obfuscation and canonical checksums
description: Customer requests a time-bounded "playback" export for a legal discovery window (2026-02-10T00:00:00Z to 2026-02-15T23:59:59Z) that meets the following constraints: 1) Remove or obfuscate any customer-provided PII at entity level (names, SSNs, account numbers) while preserving conversation structure and action timestamps; 2) Provide a canonical, tamper-evident checksum manifest (SHA256 per payload + HMAC envelope signed with KMS) that proves ordering and integrity for chain-of-custody; 3) Include RFC3161 timestamp for the manifest; 4) Allow partial playback of a single tenant's events filtered by session_id and model_version; 5) Export must be available as a downloadable bundle and as a short-lived S3 presigned URL for third-party counsel. Customer explicitly requests that model-generated suggestions that echo PII are redacted but system-level metadata (route, model_version, request_id, timestamps) remains intact for forensic traceability.
impact: FinSentry legal team needs an evidentiary bundle for a subpoena. They cannot accept full raw logs containing sensitive client identifiers. Lack of a verified manifest and per-entity redaction blocks legal compliance and delays the matter. High urgency; requested turnaround within 5 business days.
environment_details: Production tenant: tenant_id=fs-prod-09. Observed ingestion across multiple hosts in us-east-1 during window. Standard audit retention configured (90 days) with archival to s3://redwood-legal-archives/fs-prod-09/.
steps_to_reproduce_request: 1) Customer uploaded a legal evidence request via Console -> Support -> Evidence Export. 2) Attached subpoena and redaction rules CSV with entity types and regexes. 3) Selected window and requested 'canonical manifest + RFC3161' option. 4) Support validated request and escalated to Eng/Security for safe export.
expected_behavior: Generate an export that: - excludes or pseudonymizes PII per customer's redaction spec, - retains event ordering and request-level metadata, - includes SHA256 checksums per artifact plus a KMS-signed manifest, - provides RFC3161 timestamp token attached to the manifest, and - is delivered via encrypted S3 bundle with audit trail entries recorded in tenant audit stream.
actual_behavior: Initial export produced by the quick-export tool contained full text payloads (including unredacted PII) and only MD5 checksums with no RFC3161 timestamp. The customer rejected the bundle and requested re-run with stronger guarantees and an auditable manifest. The quick-export path does not currently support entity-level redaction based on customer-specified regexes.

investigation_notes: - Support verified customer's redaction CSV and regex rules; the quick-export path ignores custom regexes. - Export service v2 supports 'field-mappings' but currently only for preconfigured tenant profiles. - KMS-signed manifests are supported by manifest-service but RFC3161 stamping requires a separate timestamping service which is off-path for immediate ad-hoc exports. - A safe process must be used to redact model-generated PII: recommend entity recognition + deterministic pseudonymization with reversible mapping kept in encrypted vault (if customer requests reversible mapping, requires legal authorization).
mitigation_and_workaround: 1) Manual pipeline: create a copy of the requested event slice, run redactor job (uses NER + customer's regexes) in isolated processing environment, generate SHA256 checksums, call manifest-service to produce KMS-signed envelope, and submit RFC3161 request to timestamping service. 2) Deliver bundle to customer via an expiring presigned S3 URL (7-day) and notify via secure email. 3) Log all operator actions to audit trail and provide operator-signed statement for chain-of-custody.
work_remaining: - Build a one-off job to run redaction rules over the specified window (ENG task). - Wire the job output into manifest-service to produce SHA256 + KMS-signed envelope (ENG/Security). - Trigger RFC3161 timestamping and attach token (Security/Infra). - Prepare delivery package and legal attestation (Support + Legal).
